project.name: Hackathon Team Voting
project.description: Create a simple voting app for the hackathon teams shown in the attached photo

text.content:
Marcus: Can we make a small app that shows the votes for each team?

Priya: Yes. Add a small QR code for each team. When a user scans it, redirect them to that team's voting page.

Marcus: Keep the voting page simple, with a submit button they can use to vote for the team.

screenshots.description: Image containing the hackathon team list
